title: Compare revenue with the margin it earned
description: A combo chart draws one measure as bars and another as a line on its own axis, so the reader sees both against the same quarters.
version: 0.0.1
styles: [scientific]
---

## Margin rose as revenue grew

These illustrative figures give revenue per quarter as bars on the axis at the left and the margin as a line on the axis at the right. The two axes have their own scales, so read each against its own labels.

```chart
type: combo
title: Revenue grew by half and the margin gained nine points
subtitle: Revenue in thousands of dollars, margin in percent
data:
  inline:
    - quarter: Q1
      revenue: 120
      margin: 18
    - quarter: Q2
      revenue: 150
      margin: 22
    - quarter: Q3
      revenue: 135
      margin: 20
    - quarter: Q4
      revenue: 180
      margin: 27
encoding: {x: quarter, y: revenue, line: margin}
axes:
  y: {label: Revenue, unit: $}
  y2: {label: Margin, unit: "%"}
```

*Source: Illustrative values.*

Use the keyboard or pointer to read each quarter's revenue and margin together.
